maddeler.e:
أتوافد (form VI)
# أَتَوَافَدُ (ʔatawāfadu) /ʔa.ta.waː.fa.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# أَتَوَافَدَ (ʔatawāfada) /ʔa.ta.waː.fa.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# أَتَوَافَدْ (ʔatawāfad) /ʔa.ta.waː.fad/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
